verifier_definitions.confirmed_green: An independent adversary built/ran the unit's real tests AND found no bypass; the invariant held.
verifier_definitions.committed: Unit is committed on lak-e2e and its own tests pass at HEAD, but it has NOT cleared independent adversarial verification.
verifier_definitions.committed_bypass_found: Committed and self-green, but an independent adversary found the test asserts an invariant it does not actually prove.
verifier_definitions.red: Tests fail; worktree was reverted to last green.

units.bypass: test_two_racing_drains_never_double_lease_any_wake simulates contention by having the PARENT test process hold the flock, then asserts the second drain bounces to status=lock_held with completed_cycles=0. The no-double-lease invariant is therefore only proven against a SERIALIZED winner that runs AFTER the lock is released (single 'leased' transition per wake_id). It does NOT prove the invariant under two genuinely concurrent OS daemon processes racing for the same wake. The lock-bounce is real; 'never double-lease under a real race' is asserted-not-proven.
units.verifier_recommendation: Add a real-concurrency variant: spawn two actual subprocess daemons (multiprocessing/subprocess) against the same store with NO externally-held lock, let them race, then assert each wake_id has exactly one 'leased' ledger transition and attempt==1 across the merged ledger. If the lease primitive cannot guarantee single-lease under true OS-level contention (e.g. flock acquire/lease-write is not atomic across the lease boundary), that is a real kernel finding to surface, not a test to relax. Until that variant is green under a real race, keep this unit at committed_bypass_found, not confirmed_green. The other 7 matrix assertions (subset-authority subagent, mixed-queue single-drain, source closeback, evidence-only no-mutation, crash recovery, escalation-denied) are sound and independently valuable.

honest_state: Nine of ten units are confirmed_green: an independent adversary built or ran each one's real tests and the gates held under forgery, traversal, evidence-only-denial, tamper-evidence, dry-run non-mutation, crash recovery, and on-disk ledger replay. The kernel genuinely LEARNS (hash-chained per-agent lessons ledger, automatic run-level LEARN hook), EVOLVES under governance (skill_promote gated on operator-seeded evidence; self_edit constrained to own-skill-files via the apply_patch denial ladder), HOLDS ITS OWN CONTEXT (durable wake/daemon-cycle ledgers that replay and verify from a fresh store), and runs single OR coordinated (a real subprocess daemon drains a mixed multi-agent queue end-to-end). The single unconfirmed unit is the capstone multi-agent matrix: it is committed and self-green, but its no-double-lease guarantee is asserted against a SERIALIZED winner (parent-held lock), not proven under two genuinely concurrent OS daemons racing the same wake — a real-concurrency variant is required before it earns confirmed_green. So: the metabolism and single-daemon autonomy axes are adversarially solid; the multi-agent COORDINATION-under-real-race claim is the one remaining honest gap between this kernel and a fully-proven 'extremely autonomous, single OR coordinated' Living vision.
